subject: Open call: Lighthouse Studio Residency 2027
body: We invite painters and textile artists to apply for a six-week residency in the old lighthouse keeper's house. Deadline 28 February 2027. The residency runs from 1 May to 15 June 2027. Studio, lodging and a stipend of 1,200 are provided.

subject: Call for chamber orchestra composers
body: New works for chamber orchestra, premiered at the spring festival. Deadline 15 January 2027.

subject: Small Projects Fund: round three is open
body: Grants of up to 3,000 for small projects by artists in the region: a publication, a workshop series or a first exhibition of new work. Deadline 31 January 2027, decisions in March.
